note: 4 Nov 2026 - 'Want to Get Rich? Read These 10 Books First' (Rumble v7htumc). Same-day run, Kevin's newest upload, mined thoroughly per Kamay's note in source_plan.json.

clips.send: A dad sends this to his teenage son who says he's too busy for homework - awe that the richest man alive still finds the hour.
clips.caption:
Elon Musk reads for one hour a day, five days a week. He says it's the most important thing he does — more important than any meeting, any deal.

Kevin Trudeau asked him how he learned to build rockets. His answer: I read.

The richest man alive makes time to read every day. Most people say they're too busy for fifteen minutes.

Leaders are always readers. If you're not learning, you're already behind the people who are.

What's the last book that actually changed how you think?

#kevintrudeau #richhabits #readmorebooks #elonmusk #selfdevelopment #moneymindset

clips.send: A friend sends this to someone who always has an excuse for why they're still broke - anger at being called out, but true.
clips.caption:
You say you want to be rich. You say you want a better life. But are you willing to do what it takes?

Kevin Trudeau doesn't sugarcoat it: if you won't make time to learn, you're lying to yourself about wanting more.

Failures are good at one thing — making excuses. Successful people do what the rest are still talking about.

Stop blaming the economy, your boss, your bad luck. The gap between broke and rich is usually just discipline.

Which excuse have you been hiding behind the longest?

#kevintrudeau #stopmakingexcuses #successmindset #discipline #richmindset #selfimprovement

clips.send: Someone forwards this to a friend bragging about their salary - awe and a little shade, since Kevin spends more than that in a week.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau once sat with multi-millionaires in the Billionaire Boys Club. One member handed out a list of over a thousand books he'd read in five years, ranked by how much he liked them.

Everyone in that room was worth over a hundred million dollars, and every one of them read constantly.

Meanwhile someone bragged about making half a million a year. Kevin's reply: he couldn't go back to living on half a million a week.

The top don't read occasionally — they read like it's their job, because it built their job.

How many books have you finished this year?

#kevintrudeau #billionairemindset #readtogetrich #wealthhabits #richpeoplethink #successbooks

clips.send: A skeptic's friend sends this to someone who mocks manifesting - proof a NASA physicist took it seriously, sparking curiosity and awe.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau calls this book hard to find: The Science Behind the Secret, by Travis Taylor, a PhD physicist from Skinwalker Ranch who worked with NASA on classified aerial research.

The book lays out the actual physics behind manifesting and the law of attraction — written before quantum computers, before AI even existed.

Once you start reading it, Kevin says, you realize the science was describing reality decades before we had the tech to prove it.

If a NASA physicist takes manifesting seriously, maybe it's worth five minutes of yours.

#kevintrudeau #lawofattraction #manifestation #nasascientist #scienceofmanifesting #mindsetbooks

clips.send: A struggling performer or artist sends this to a friend who feels forgotten and broke - awe that even Liberace started there.
clips.caption:
Liberace was broke. So was Phyllis Diller. So were a whole list of Hollywood performers scraping by, barely getting booked, before they found one book.

It was called The Magic of Believing. Kevin Trudeau says it's the book these broke performers credit with teaching them to use their mind to create their own reality — right before they became stars.

Not a lucky break, not a connection. One book changed how they saw themselves.

Your mind creates what you expect long before it creates what you have. What have you been expecting lately?

#kevintrudeau #magicofbelieving #mindsetshift #lawofattraction #believeit #selfimage

clips.send: Someone sends this to a friend who name-drops books they read years ago but never changed - a little anger at being called out.
clips.caption:
Nobody knows how to talk to people anymore — everyone's on a phone, texting instead of connecting. That's why Kevin Trudeau says interpersonal skills are the most underrated superpower you can have.

The two books: How to Win Friends and Influence People by Dale Carnegie, and Napoleon Hill's Think and Grow Rich, the manuscript Kevin says helped him make hundreds of millions.

Here's the catch: read either one years ago and never applied it, and you don't actually know it. To know and not to do is not to know.

Have you read a book that changed your thinking, or just your bookshelf?

#kevintrudeau #thinkandgrowrich #dalecarnegie #applywhatyoulearn #selfdevelopment #successhabits

clips.send: A friend shares this with someone who needs a morning mindset reset - awe at how one line from a billionaire sticks.
clips.caption:
Yesterday is history. Tomorrow is a mystery. Today is a gift — that's why it's called the present. One phrase, Kevin Trudeau says, can contain a whole book, like a seed contains a tree.

That's the idea behind two of his own books, Nuggets of Gold and the Guru Cal Lessons — short phrases you read in five minutes that stay with you all day.

One lesson quotes J. Paul Getty and John D. Rockefeller: persistence and determination alone are omnipotent. Another: control your mind and your thoughts, and you control your life.

Which phrase would you want to read every morning?

#kevintrudeau #nuggetsofgold #rockefeller #mindsetquotes #selfmastery #dailywisdom

clips.send: A workaholic sends this to a friend glued to their phone - anxiety that they're burning hours Elon Musk would never waste.
clips.caption:
Elon Musk locks the door. He shuts his phone off completely — no pings, no notifications. Then he reads one hour, five days a week, with zero interruptions.

Kevin Trudeau points out Warren Buffett said almost the same thing: rich people invest time and energy, especially early in their career, into personal development. Not luxury, not relaxation — learning.

Two of the richest men who ever lived both protected one uninterrupted hour to make themselves smarter. Most people can't put their phone down for ten minutes.

What would you learn with one undistracted hour today?

#kevintrudeau #elonmusk #warrenbuffett #deepwork #personaldevelopment #richhabits

clips.send: Someone sends this to a friend who keeps saying I'll start Monday - a nudge mixed with hope that ten minutes is enough to begin.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's encouragement is simple: if you're serious about making more money and building the life you want, it starts with feeding your mind — starting now, not someday.

You don't have to jump from zero to Elon Musk's one hour, five days a week. Start with one day a week for ten minutes. Lock the door. No phone. Just read.

Then build — two days, then three, then thirty minutes, then an hour. Consistency beats intensity every time.

Kevin's promise: keep learning something new daily, and he'll see you at the top.

What day this week will you lock the door for ten minutes?

#kevintrudeau #startsmall #consistencywins #selfdevelopment #richmindset #10minutehabit
